faq.heading: Have some questions?
faq.q1: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a1: Share your details through our appointment form. Our team will contact you to confirm a suitable time and discuss your ERP requirements.
faq.a2: Falcon ERP typically goes live in 4–8 weeks, including data migration, training, and customization. Compare that to 6–12 months with SAP or Oracle.
faq.a3: Yes. Falcon ERP has native ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing built into the core system — not bolted on as an add-on. We're fully certified.
faq.a4: Absolutely. We have a dedicated migration team that handles data extraction, transformation, and validation. Most migrations complete within 2–4 weeks.
faq.a5: Yes, on-premise is our default deployment model. Your data stays on your servers, in your country. We also offer cloud and hybrid options.
faq.a6: Falcon has pre-built templates for 9 industries: Retail, Manufacturing, Construction, Real Estate, Hospitality, Healthcare, Education, Logistics, and Trading.
faq.q7: What kind of support do you offer?
faq.a7: We offer 5 SLA tiers from Basic (5 hrs/month, 48hr response) to VIP (unlimited hours, 1hr response). All plans include WhatsApp support.

desktopPage.heroTitle: Your Data. Your Servers. Your Rules.
desktopPage.heroSubtitle: Enterprise-grade ERP with full data sovereignty. ZATCA-compliant, Arabic-native, and deployed on your infrastructure — not someone else's cloud.
desktopPage.problemTitle: Why most MENA businesses regret their ERP choice
desktopPage.problem1Title: Too much complexity for basic workflows
desktopPage.problem1Desc: Global ERPs can require lengthy implementations while many features go unused. Your team needs a system that fits its work.
desktopPage.problem2Title: Your data lives on foreign servers
desktopPage.problem2Desc: Cloud-only ERPs store your financial records, employee data, and trade secrets on servers outside the Kingdom. That is a PDPL compliance risk.
desktopPage.problem3Title: Slow implementations that drain your team
desktopPage.problem3Desc: 6-12 month rollouts mean lost productivity, frustrated employees, and delayed ROI. Your business cannot wait that long.
desktopPage.modulesTitle: Everything your business needs — nothing it does not
desktopPage.modulesSubtitle: Six integrated modules designed for MENA businesses. Arabic-native, ZATCA-certified, and ready to deploy on your servers.
desktopPage.f1Desc: General ledger, AP/AR, fixed assets, budgeting, multi-currency, and bank reconciliation. Full Arabic financial reporting out of the box.
desktopPage.f2Desc: Real-time stock tracking across multiple warehouses. Barcode scanning, automated reordering, batch/serial tracking, and min-max alerts.
desktopPage.f3Desc: Complete employee lifecycle management with GOSI integration, WPS compliance, leave management, and end-of-service calculations.
desktopPage.f4Desc: Track every lead from first contact to closed deal. Sales pipeline, quotation builder, follow-up automation, and revenue forecasting.
desktopPage.f5Desc: Bill of materials, production planning, work orders, quality control, and cost tracking. Built for factories and workshops across KSA.
desktopPage.f6Desc: Native ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing with QR code generation, XML submission, credit/debit notes, and full Arabic RTL support. No add-ons needed.
desktopPage.howItWorksSubtitle: From first call to full deployment in 4-8 weeks. No surprises, no hidden fees.
desktopPage.step1Desc: We discuss your current workflows, pain points, and requirements, then agree on the right implementation approach.
desktopPage.step2Desc: Our team handles installation, data migration, customization, and integrations. Your staff receives hands-on training throughout the process.
desktopPage.step3Desc: Launch with confidence. We provide on-site support during your first week live, plus 90 days of priority support to ensure a smooth transition.
desktopPage.midCtaTitle: Take control of your ERP and your data.
desktopPage.midCtaSubtitle: Talk with our team about a secure, locally aligned ERP for your business.
desktopPage.whoItsForTitle: Built for the industries that power the MENA economy
desktopPage.testimonialQuote: We evaluated SAP Business One and Oracle NetSuite before choosing Falcon. The real win was going live in just 6 weeks with full ZATCA compliance. Our data stays on our servers in Riyadh, exactly where it should be.
desktopPage.finalCtaSubtitle: Tell us about your business and we will prepare a personalized ERP roadmap — free of charge.
desktopPage.formDisclaimer: We will respond within 24 hours. No spam, ever.
desktopPage.ctaTitle: Ready to take control of your data?
desktopPage.ctaSubtitle: Deploy Falcon ERP on your own servers. Full sovereignty, full compliance, full power.

cloudPage.heroSubtitle: Full-power ERP in the cloud. Access your business from any device, any location. Real-time data, automatic updates, zero server headaches.
cloudPage.problemTitle: Your desktop ERP is holding your business back
cloudPage.problem1Desc: Need to approve a purchase order from a client meeting? Check inventory while visiting a warehouse? Desktop ERP says no. Your business says you need to.
cloudPage.problem2Desc: Branch managers emailing spreadsheets, warehouse counts that are always outdated, financial reports that take days to compile. Sound familiar?
cloudPage.problem3Title: Paying for servers you should not manage
cloudPage.problem3Desc: Server hardware, IT staff for maintenance, backup tapes, power costs — you are running a data center when you should be running your business.
cloudPage.problemCtaText: Switch to cloud and work from anywhere
cloudPage.featuresTitle: Work from anywhere. Stay in control.
cloudPage.featuresSubtitle: All the power of Falcon ERP, delivered through the cloud with zero infrastructure overhead.
cloudPage.f1Desc: Full ERP access from your phone, tablet, or laptop. Approve transactions, check reports, and manage operations from anywhere in the world.
cloudPage.f2Desc: Every branch, warehouse, and team member sees the same data at the same time. No more version conflicts or outdated spreadsheets.
cloudPage.f3Desc: Always running the latest version. Security patches, ZATCA regulation changes, and new features applied automatically — zero downtime.
cloudPage.f4Desc: Manage 2 locations or 200 from a single dashboard. Branch-level permissions, consolidated reporting, and inter-branch transfers in real time.
cloudPage.f5Desc: 256-bit encryption, automated daily backups, SOC 2 compliance, and optional MENA-region data residency. Your data is safer than on-premise.
cloudPage.f6Desc: Redundant infrastructure across multiple availability zones. 24/7 monitoring with automatic failover. We guarantee it in writing.
cloudPage.howItWorksTitle: A clear path to cloud ERP
cloudPage.howItWorksSubtitle: Start with an appointment, then plan onboarding around your team.
cloudPage.step1Desc: Tell us about your team and workflows. We will contact you to arrange a convenient conversation.
cloudPage.step2Desc: Upload your existing data via Excel, CSV, or our migration tool. Our team can help import from SAP, Oracle, QuickBooks, or any legacy system.
cloudPage.step3Desc: Log in from any device and start managing your business. Add team members, configure branches, and scale as you grow. We handle the infrastructure.
cloudPage.midCtaTitle: Your competitors are already working from anywhere. Are you?
cloudPage.midCtaSubtitle: See how Falcon Cloud can support your branches and remote teams.
cloudPage.whoItsForTitle: Built for businesses that refuse to stand still
cloudPage.whoItsForCtaText: See how it fits your business
cloudPage.testimonialQuote: We run 12 retail branches across KSA. Before Falcon Cloud, reconciling inventory took 3 days every month. Now it happens in real time. The ZATCA compliance update rolled out automatically — we did not have to lift a finger. Best decision we made.

odooPage.heroTitle: Odoo Done Right. For the Middle East.
odooPage.heroSubtitle: Expert Odoo implementation, customization, and support from the only partner that truly understands MENA compliance, Arabic localization, and regional business culture.
odooPage.problemTitle: Why most Odoo projects in the MENA region fail
odooPage.problem1Desc: Most Odoo partners copy-paste European workflows into MENA businesses. They do not understand ZATCA, WPS, GOSI, or how business actually works in the Gulf.
odooPage.problem2Desc: 60% of Odoo projects in the region go over budget or fail entirely. Companies end up paying a second firm to fix what the first one broke.
odooPage.problem3Title: No Arabic support when you need it
odooPage.problem3Desc: Your support ticket goes to a team in Europe who responds in 48 hours — in English. Meanwhile, your Arabic-speaking accountant is stuck and your invoices are late.
odooPage.servicesTitle: Complete Odoo expertise for the Middle East
odooPage.servicesSubtitle: From first assessment to ongoing support, we handle every aspect of your Odoo journey with deep MENA knowledge.
odooPage.f1Desc: Full Odoo deployment tailored for MENA. Requirements gathering, configuration, data migration, testing, and go-live in 4-8 weeks with hands-on training.
odooPage.f2Desc: Custom modules, workflows, reports, and integrations built to match your exact processes. From ZATCA e-invoicing to warehouse automation.
odooPage.f3Desc: Seamless migration from SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or legacy systems to Odoo. Zero data loss guaranteed with full validation testing.
odooPage.f4Desc: Hands-on Arabic and English training for every role — from end users to system administrators. On-site or remote, with recorded sessions for future reference.
odooPage.f5Desc: 5 SLA tiers from basic to VIP. Arabic-speaking support team, dedicated account managers, WhatsApp support, and 1-hour response on critical issues.
odooPage.f6Desc: ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing, Arabic localization, PDPL data protection, GOSI/WPS payroll compliance, and region-specific tax configurations. All built in.
odooPage.howItWorksTitle: A proven path to Odoo success
odooPage.howItWorksSubtitle: Our structured approach eliminates the guesswork and ensures your Odoo project delivers real results.
odooPage.step1Desc: We map your current processes, identify gaps, and define clear requirements before planning the implementation together.
odooPage.step2Desc: Our team configures Odoo, builds customizations, migrates your data, and runs thorough testing. You validate every module before go-live.
odooPage.step3Desc: Launch with on-site support during week one. Then transition to your chosen SLA tier for ongoing support, updates, and continuous optimization.
odooPage.midCtaTitle: Your Odoo project deserves a partner who understands the region.
odooPage.midCtaSubtitle: Over 100 successful Odoo implementations across KSA, UAE, and Egypt. Let us show you how we do it differently.

legal.privacyIntro: At Falcon Smart Solutions, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our website and services.
legal.dataCollectionText: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, company name, and job title when you fill out forms on our website. We also automatically collect technical data such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited.
legal.dataUsageText: We use your information to respond to your inquiries, provide product demonstrations, send relevant communications about our ERP solutions, and improve our website and services. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
legal.dataSecurityText: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data. For on-premise ERP solutions, your business data remains entirely within your infrastructure. Cloud-hosted data is secured with enterprise-grade encryption.
legal.contactText: If you have questions about this policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact us at info@falcon-v.com.
